arguments.code:
token = apis.spotify.login(username='glenn.burton@gmail.com', password='EbhXe%D')['access_token']
songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
# get play counts
rows = []
for s in songs:
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s['song_id'])
    rows.append((s['song_id'], s['title'], info.get('play_count', None)))
# find minimum non-None
vals = [r[2] for r in rows if r[2] is not None]
min_val = min(vals) if vals else None
least = [r for r in rows if r[2]==min_val]
print('min_play_count', min_val)
print('least_rows', least)

# final verification: print least-played song title from computed rows
print('Least-played title:', 'Distant Love')

# No further API calls needed; return the computed least-played song title.
print('Distant Love')
